name: Dividend ETF (Income-Focused)

yield.notes: VYM, SCHD, DVY type funds. Better cash yield than index ETFs; slightly lower total return.

flags: Dividend cuts are possible in recessions
Interest rate sensitivity: dividend stocks often fall when rates rise
Qualified dividends receive preferential tax treatment

startup_checklist: Choose fund: SCHD (Schwab, 0.06% ER), VYM (Vanguard, 0.06% ER), or DVY (iShares, 0.38% ER)
Enable DRIP (dividend reinvestment) or collect dividends as income
Track annual dividend income and compare yield vs benchmark quarterly
failure_modes: Companies in fund cut dividends during recession
Rising rates reduce share price (rate-sensitive sectors)
kill_criteria: Fund dividend yield drops below 2% for 2 consecutive quarters
sources_note: Yield ranges from ETF provider data and Morningstar.
